headline: Chunky south swell but cross-on wind muddles it — morning's your window.
today: Total waves near 3.3ft is the most size around, though the fair angle and SW cross-on keep it textured all day. Dawn is the least wind so hit it early on the incoming toward the 4:34p high. Fish or shortboard, expect workable but not clean.

daysToWatch.note: Biggest of the week to 3ft, but wind goes onshore by afternoon. Morning cross-on session is the call before it falls apart.
Light ENE at dawn gives a brief clean window before SSW onshore builds through the day. Early only.
